method: auditSifliImage verifies ELF/raw PT_LOAD identity; inspectSifliResetStartup recognizes the exact reset prologue, copy loops and branch encodings, and checks literal-pool ranges against ELF segments. Published ELF symbols identify Reset_Handler, memset, SystemInit and main. No firmware bytes are modified or distributed.
scope: This is binary startup-path evidence, not execution or physical validation. The contents of SRAM before reset entry, clock/flash/cache/security state, SiFli ROM, LCPU, controller and MMIO behavior remain unknown. ELF zero-file stack sections are not cleared by this reset routine; that does not prove their prior contents.
